title: Today Could Be OK
logline: A nervous little squirrel tries to reach the Learning Circle, and a brave young bear helps him discover that belonging starts when you stop hiding what makes you different.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.
A tiny puff of yellow pollen floats through the air… … and lands right on Keen's nose.
Beat.
Keen's nose TWITCHES. His eyes water. He tries to hold it. He holds it. He holds it. He almost stops —

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: ACHOO!

beats.storyBeat: Keen sneaks toward the honeycomb like it is a grand mission, but the sleeping bee keeps turning the simple snack into a comic test of nerve.
beats.want: Get the honey without being stopped.
beats.need: Be honest about wanting something instead of pretending he is perfectly smooth.
beats.kidRead: A bear is tiptoeing for honey and trying not to get caught.
beats.adultRead: Courage starts as playful risk, not confidence; Keen is already acting brave before he feels it.
beats.emotionalIntent: Light, curious, and just a little tense.

beats.need: Accept being seen in a messy moment and keep going anyway.

orderedEvents.text: Soft mist floats through tall trees. AIDA sits beside a crystal bowl. She slowly circles a mallet around the rim. A warm tone hums through the clearing. Her ROSE QUARTZ PENDANT begins to glow. Pink light fills her eyes.
VISION – THROUGH AIDA'S EYES
A small red squirrel sits inside a hollow tree. He packs a satchel. Unpacks it. Packs it again. He doesn't move. BACK TO SCENE. Aida gently stops the bowl. She places a paw on her heart.

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: Someone needs a little help today. (AIDA reacts to off camera SNEEZE)

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: AHHHHCHHOOOOO!!! AHHHHCHHOOOOO!!!
Across the clearing Keen brushes pollen from his nose.

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: Bless you. Sounds like someone has been sniffing around Fuzzby’s honeycomb. Keen? Come with me
Keen still recovering from his sneezing attack jogs over.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Coming, Aida! AHHHHCHHOOOOO!!!

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: Bless you Keen.

beats.storyBeat: Aida's crystal vision opens on a squirrel who cannot quite leave home, and her gentle certainty tells us this is the day someone needs to be found.
beats.want: Understand who needs help and where they are stuck.
beats.need: Trust the quiet signal and act on it.
beats.kidRead: Aida sees a worried little squirrel in her magic bowl.
beats.adultRead: The visionary beat is really about a leader noticing a child's fear before the child can say it out loud.

orderedEvents.text: Warm sunlight fills a cozy hollow tree. BO, a young red squirrel, sits beside a small satchel. Next to him lies a shiny CONKER. His Mum calls to him from offscreen, we never actually see his Mum.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo's Mum
orderedEvents.text: BO, it’s time for you to go to the Learning Circle? Don’t forget your lunch.
Bo calls back to his Mum

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: I’ll go in a minute Mum.
(to the conker) Or forty. Forty sounds much better to me.
He places the conker in the bag and walks towards the front door but just as he opens the door Bo freezes in place. Panic sets in.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Maybe, I’ll go tomorrow instead. Tomorrow sounds much better than today. Tomorrow everything will OK, not today.
Bo scurries back inside and takes the Conker out of his bag. Bo realizes he must go – today.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Today could be OK.
He sighs deeply and then puts the Conker back in the bag again. But his anxiety starts to rise again.
But, Today might not be OK.
Bo pulls the Conker out of the bag -again - and holds it in his hands. Panic really kicks in.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: What if it’s not OK?!

beats.storyBeat: Bo stalls in his hollow tree, packs and repacks, and lets fear make the front door feel too big.
beats.want: Stay safe for one more minute.
beats.need: Admit the day is harder than he wants to say.
beats.kidRead: A squirrel keeps changing his mind about going out.
beats.adultRead: This is avoidance as self-protection; the conker and satchel become little shields.

orderedEvents.text: A shadow appears at the doorway. Keen appears at the open door and gently taps on the hollow tree. Shave and a Haircut knock. He peeks inside.
Beat.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Hi! I'm Keen.
Bo jumps. The conker flies into the air. He catches it, fumbles it several times and finally hugs it. BO looks from the Conker to KEEN immediately

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Aida sent me. She thought we should meet.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Hi Keen, my name is Bo and I am really worried. What if nobody likes me at the Learning Circle? I don't think I can go today. What if my tail does the THING?
His tail suddenly POOFS twice its size. Bo grabs it.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Stop it! Please just be a normal tail!
The tail refuses. POOFS twice its size again.
Keen stares. Impressed.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Whoa. Your tail is AMAZING.
Bo pauses his struggle with his tail and begins to calm down.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: …you think so?

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Mine does nothing. Watch.
Keen turns around and wiggles. His tail hangs there. Completely still.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: See? Nothing.
Bo looks at Keen's tail. Then at his own. His tail slowly deflates. He almost smiles.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Let’s go for a walk and get some fresh air. Fresh air always helps.
BO’s smile grows to a full smile.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: That does sound nice.
His tail deflates, picks up his bag and walks out the door with Keen.

beats.storyBeat: Keen arrives with a gentle knock, sees Bo's tail, and proves that oddness can be funny before it can be shameful.
beats.want: Decide whether this stranger is safe.
beats.need: Let himself be seen without immediately hiding the weird part.
beats.kidRead: A friendly bear comes to visit and thinks the tail is amazing.
beats.adultRead: Keen's warmth reframes Bo's panic; the joke is that the thing Bo fears is exactly what makes him lovable.
beats.emotionalIntent: First trust, then a little grin.

orderedEvents.text: A winding path through the Whispering Woods. Sunlight flickers through the leaves. Bo walks beside Keen. Step. Step. BO Walks with a newfound confidence, no longer concerned about his tail doing 'THE THING'. Keen and Bo walk along doing a countdown, each time they get to 1, BO’s tail does 'THE THING' on command. The tails POOFS UP and then shrinks back to normal before POOFING UP again each time they count.
Bo’s tail does THE THING on command. POOF!
BO SPINS and twirls. POOF! The tail does THE THING again.

POOF! Bo giggles. They continue walking. Bo lightly kicks leaves as he moves. BO hears the bears chatter from the Learning Circle nearby. Bo suddenly stops. He grips his satchel tightly. His smile fades.

beats.want: Stay in control of the feeling.
beats.need: Discover that shared play can make the unknown feel smaller.
beats.kidRead: They count down and the tail does the funny thing on purpose.
beats.adultRead: The game is a pressure valve; the body becomes a joke, and that joke lets Bo breathe.

orderedEvents.text: Bo stares down the path toward the Learning Circle. AIDA walks down the path towards BO and Keen.

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: Hi Keen, I see you have met a new friend.
Bo glances up, curious.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Yes.
Keen smiles and places his paw around BO’s shoulder.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Bo, this is Aida.
Bo looks down, sheepish. His ears lower. He whispers a small, nervous hello.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Hi, Ada.
Aida sits beside Bo, leaving space between them. She notices his satchel.

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: You packed your bag.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Four times.

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: I would have done five.
Bo looks at her. He softens.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: You get scared too?

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: Every single time.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: But you still go?

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida

Beat.
Wind moves gently through the trees.

beats.want: Get permission to be afraid and still belong.
beats.need: Receive care without being pushed.
beats.kidRead: The wise bear sits down and makes space for him.
beats.adultRead: Aida's stillness and honesty give Bo a model: fear is not a disqualifier; it is a doorway.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen

Blue light joins the pink. The forest path glows, shining a clear way towards the Learning Circle. Bo is amazed and smiles bigger than ever before as the joined light reaches his feet.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Every single time.

inputs.title: Today Could Be OK
inputs.logline: A nervous little squirrel tries to reach the Learning Circle, and a brave young bear helps him discover that belonging starts when you stop hiding what makes you different.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.
A tiny puff of yellow pollen floats through the air… … and lands right on Keen's nose.
Beat.
Keen's nose TWITCHES. His eyes water. He tries to hold it. He holds it. He holds it. He almost stops —

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: ACHOO!

beats.storyBeat: Keen sneaks toward the honeycomb like it is a grand mission, but the sleeping bee keeps turning the simple snack into a comic test of nerve.
beats.want: Get the honey without being stopped.
beats.need: Be honest about wanting something instead of pretending he is perfectly smooth.
beats.kidRead: A bear is tiptoeing for honey and trying not to get caught.
beats.adultRead: Courage starts as playful risk, not confidence; Keen is already acting brave before he feels it.
beats.emotionalIntent: Light, curious, and just a little tense.

orderedEvents.text: Warm sunlight fills a cozy hollow tree. BO, a young red squirrel, sits beside a small satchel. Next to him lies a shiny CONKER. His Mum calls to him from offscreen, we never actually see his Mum.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo's Mum
orderedEvents.text: BO, it’s time for you to go to the Learning Circle? Don’t forget your lunch.
Bo calls back to his Mum

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: I’ll go in a minute Mum.
(to the conker) Or forty. Forty sounds much better to me.
He places the conker in the bag and walks towards the front door but just as he opens the door Bo freezes in place. Panic sets in.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Maybe, I’ll go tomorrow instead. Tomorrow sounds much better than today. Tomorrow everything will OK, not today.
Bo scurries back inside and takes the Conker out of his bag. Bo realizes he must go – today.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Today could be OK.
He sighs deeply and then puts the Conker back in the bag again. But his anxiety starts to rise again.
But, Today might not be OK.
Bo pulls the Conker out of the bag -again - and holds it in his hands. Panic really kicks in.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: What if it’s not OK?!

beats.storyBeat: Bo stalls in his hollow tree, packs and repacks, and lets fear make the front door feel too big.
beats.want: Stay safe for one more minute.
beats.need: Admit the day is harder than he wants to say.
beats.kidRead: A squirrel keeps changing his mind about going out.
beats.adultRead: This is avoidance as self-protection; the conker and satchel become little shields.

orderedEvents.text: A shadow appears at the doorway. Keen appears at the open door and gently taps on the hollow tree. Shave and a Haircut knock. He peeks inside.
Beat.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Hi! I'm Keen.
Bo jumps. The conker flies into the air. He catches it, fumbles it several times and finally hugs it. BO looks from the Conker to KEEN immediately

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Aida sent me. She thought we should meet.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Hi Keen, my name is Bo and I am really worried. What if nobody likes me at the Learning Circle? I don't think I can go today. What if my tail does the THING?
His tail suddenly POOFS twice its size. Bo grabs it.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: Stop it! Please just be a normal tail!
The tail refuses. POOFS twice its size again.
Keen stares. Impressed.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Whoa. Your tail is AMAZING.
Bo pauses his struggle with his tail and begins to calm down.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: …you think so?

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Mine does nothing. Watch.
Keen turns around and wiggles. His tail hangs there. Completely still.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: See? Nothing.
Bo looks at Keen's tail. Then at his own. His tail slowly deflates. He almost smiles.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Let’s go for a walk and get some fresh air. Fresh air always helps.
BO’s smile grows to a full smile.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: That does sound nice.
His tail deflates, picks up his bag and walks out the door with Keen.

beats.need: Let himself be seen without immediately hiding the weird part.
beats.kidRead: A friendly bear comes to visit and thinks the tail is amazing.
beats.adultRead: Keen's warmth reframes Bo's panic; the joke is that the thing Bo fears is exactly what makes him lovable.
beats.emotionalIntent: First trust, then a little grin.
